QuestInfo.name: Burying Fossils
QuestInfo.0: Ask Sean in the Relic Excavation Camp about the skeletons in the Excavation Site.
QuestInfo.1:
Defeat the monsters to help the excavation get back on track.

#b#m102040300#, #m102040301##k : Skeledog, Mummydog
#b#m102040400#, #m102040500##k : Skeleton Soldier, Skeleton Officer
QuestInfo.2: You eliminated Skeledogs, Mummydogs, Skeleton Soldiers, and Skeleton Officers and helped the excavators get back on track.

0.0: Things aren't going so well, my friend. I can hardly raise my pick to an ancient relic without getting jumped by a skeleton!
0.1: My men say a weird blue gate popped up in the Excavation Site. And when the skeletons go near it, they go bonkers. Completely crazy. There might be something to that...
0.2: We'll never finish the excavation at this rate! Please get rid of those skeletons for me.

yes.0: Just eliminate 50 Skeledogs, Mummydogs, Skeleton Soldiers, and Skeleton Officers. That'll do the trick.

no.0: If we don't finish this excavation soon, it'll be a real tragedy. We need your help something fierce.

1.1: Don't go running off on me just yet! There's one more thing you can do for me.

mob.0: Please hunt down 50 Skeledogs and 50 Mummydogs in the #m102040300# and #m102040301#.
